messages:
sara_finance: Heads up — incoming EUR wire from 'Acme Labs' for invoice 3124 (€34,500). Bank posted the credit but remittance missing; beneficiary reference changed to '59382' by correspondent. Can't auto-apply.
liam_support: Copy. Can you paste the MT103 or a screenshot? We can try matching on amount + sender bank.
sara_finance: Pasting redacted MT103 snippet below. Customer also claims they included PO# PR-778 but our AP feed shows no PO on the instruction.
```
:20:TRN20260310ACME
:32A:230310EUR34500,
:50K:/12345678
ACME LABS LTD
:59:/987654321
RECEIVER CO
:70:INV 3124 PO PR-778
:72:/BNF/INVOICE:3124
```
ledgerbot: Payment posted to customer account CUST-992 but invoice 3124 not matched -> status: HOLD.
nina_ops: Looks like correspondent bank stripped or replaced the remittance info. We need an interbank trace (UETR/SRN). I can file with our bank if you can provide ordering institution details or any original payment instruction.
sara_finance: Opened ticket BANK-7841 with bank ops just now. They asked for the payer's ordering institution and any remittance-bearing fields. Requesting bank to retrieve full ordering instruction and trace id.
julian_accounting: Reminder: contract requires PO to apply payments. If payer can provide proof later we can post retro credit. If trace takes >3 business days we should consider suspense handling — do we want to issue a temp credit?
liam_support: Customer wants proof of payment to close their side. Bank ops estimate 3-5 business days for a trace. Can we ask the customer to forward the originating bank confirmation or UETR to speed up?
sara_finance: I'll email them: "Please provide the originating bank's UETR or MT103 copy." Will update BANK-7841 when they reply. @nina_ops please escalate to correspondent if bank asks for more details.
nina_ops: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with the correspondent bank this afternoon. Also flagging VAT: customer is EU and invoice shows VAT 23% — confirm tax treatment once we match payment.
ledgerbot: :money_with_wings: status changed -> "awaiting trace"
liam_support: If trace fails, fallbacks: 1) manual match with payer name + amount + date + customer confirmation, 2) place invoice into suspense and issue temporary credit if business requires.
sara_finance: Action owners: sara_finance -> request UETR from customer & update BANK-7841; nina_ops -> run interbank trace; julian_accounting -> advise on credit policy. I'll loop back here with updates.
